messages:
Kamal: Heads-up — new enterprise onboarding next week for acme-health. Need a preflight on capacity in us-west2: target 8x A100 GPUs (single job footprint), ENI/NICs per instance bumped, and subnet IP space large enough for node scale. Also need NAT gateway port limit increase for concurrent connections. Can someone open support cases with Azure and GCP and request expedited review?
Ivy: On it. I'll open cases now and ask for expedited review. Do we have subscription/project IDs and a billing owner?
Kamal: Subscriptions: sub-abc123 (prod), sub-ops456 (staging). Billing owner: Sasha. Preference: reserved monthly commit for predictable throughput, but allow spot fallback for noncritical batches.
Ivy: Created Azure case AZ-202604-98765 — asked for A100 quota increase, NIC/per-subscription limits, and vnet IP guidance. Link posted to portal. Created GCP case 123456789012345 — requested GPU quota bump and larger secondary ranges. Requested expedited handling. Providers asked for topology & justification.
Azure Support: [system] Support request AZ-202604-98765 assigned to engineer Rahul. Next update expected within 48-72h. Requested additional details: exact VM SKU (A100 v5 / a100_v5), target region, subscription ID, and justification for production allocation. Reply with 'confirm' once provided.
Sasha: Confirm. VM SKU = a100_v5, region = us-west2, subscription = sub-abc123. Cost center = COST-PLATFORM-34. Preference: reserved monthly commit; include quote for 1/3/12 month terms.
Kamal: Also need ENI/NIC per instance increased to 15 (current default 4) — these VMs will attach multiple interfaces for network isolation. If provider can't grant that, fallback plan is multi-subnet per host. Add NIC and vCPU limits to the request.
Kumar: For Azure the right ask is NIC per VM and per-subscription NIC quota; for AWS we'd request ENI and IP per ENI increases. Drafting language and adding vCPU ceilings to the ticket.
Ivy: Updated both cases with NIC + vCPU requests and uploaded topology diagram (see brief ASCII below). Also asked for temporary burst allocation for the first 72h of onboarding.
Kamal: Quick topology snippet I uploaded:
```
prod-vnet-usw2 (10.10.0.0/20)
  ├─ subnet-gpu-1 (10.10.0.0/22) -> expected max nodes 64
  ├─ subnet-gpu-2 (10.10.4.0/22) -> overflow
  └─ nat-gw -> request port limit bump to 65536
```
Ivy: Azure support requested whether we can use larger /20 or split ranges — we replied prefer single /20 for simplicity. GCP asked if preemptible is acceptable — we said prefer on-demand for the first 72h, then spot okay.
GCP Support: Case 123456789012345 assigned. Engineer asked for project number, exact regions (us-west2), and whether we require on-demand or preemptible. Suggested soft reservation while finalizing quota; will update within 24-48h.
Sasha: Also please add IAM tag: `redwood:onboard=acme-health` to both requests so procurement/billing maps correctly. Pre-authorize infra service account infra-svc@redwood-prod for provisioning.
Ivy: Tag added to both cases and service account noted. Asked Azure to attach temporary access role to infra-svc for onboarding.
Kumar: Looping in Leah (sales) to push account rep: @Leah-sales we need a channel to the Azure account team to accelerate NIC and A100 capacity. Can you nudge?
Leah-sales: Acked — I'll escalate to the account rep and request priority. Will push for a tentative capacity hold while support processes the ticket.
Kamal: Cost heads-up: projected monthly run-rate if we reserve this pool ~ $45k/month. Creating internal Cost Ops ticket to track spend and approvals. If providers can offer trial credits or accelerated onboarding we should take it.
Kumar: Opening internal COps ticket 4782 to capture burn and approval.
Azure Support: Update — engineer Rahul asked for VM counts per week and whether nodes will use accelerated networking. Please confirm.
Ivy: Confirmed counts: 8 GPUs initially, can scale to 16 within 30 days. All nodes will use accelerated networking and single NIC primary, plus up to 2 additional NICs for monitoring and management (requesting max 15 in ticket).
Kamal: Fallback plan documented here: if quota request denied, split across us-west2 (4) + us-central1 (4), use autoscaling to avoid cold starts, and use reservation/spot mix.
Sasha: Good. Also can someone estimate the one-time networking config work (route tables, firewall) for onboarding? Need an SRE ETA.
Kumar: Rough ETA: 2 engineer-days to stand up subnets, NAT config, and security group rules; another day for reservations & infra testing. Will confirm in ticket 4782.
Ivy: I'll keep updates in this thread. Posting provider responses here as they come in. :thumbsup:
Kamal: Thanks — please ping if we get any hold/denial so we can enact fallback.
Ivy: Noted. Next provider check-in due in ~24h.
